title: Kiln Rental / Firing Service
summary: The Clay Co-op offers kiln space rentals for potters who want to fire work without membership. Drop off finished, dry pottery during open hours and they fire it when enough pieces are available to fill the kiln.
how_to_join: Drop off work during open hours (Mon-Fri 10am-5pm, Sat-Sun 10am-4pm)
evidence_sentence: The membership page states 'We offer rentals of kiln space for firing your pieces of pottery.'
evidence_quote: We offer rentals of kiln space for firing your pieces of pottery. Drop off your finished pottery during our open hours and we'll get it fired when it is completely dry and when enough pieces are available to fill the kiln.
source_quote: We offer rentals of kiln space for firing your pieces of pottery. Drop off your finished pottery during our open hours and we'll get it fired when it is completely dry and when enough pieces are available to fill the kiln.
